item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Creates Adorable Festival Accessory Line for Daisy Chain Fields With 10 Female Etsy Sellers
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates on the music scene. Today, we're talking about Olivia Rodrigo, the pop star who's making waves with her upcoming festival, Daisy Chain Fields. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo has partnered with Etsy to launch a line of accessories and trinkets inspired by her festival. The collection, created by 10 women who run businesses on Etsy, includes beaded jewelry, bookmarks, pendants, and more. Rodrigo says she was inspired by the handmade aesthetic of the festival and wanted to bring it to life with this collection."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The festival, which takes place on August 29th in Irvine, California, features an all-women lineup, including Stevie Nicks and Doechii. Proceeds from the event will go towards charities that support women and girls, such as Planned Parenthood and the Center for Reproductive Rights. Fans can shop the Etsy collection online and in person at the festival grounds."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Rodrigo has been promoting the festival and her new album, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, which spent two weeks at number one on the Billboard 200. She's also been using her platform to discuss important issues, such as reproductive rights, and has sat down with leaders at the Center for Reproductive Rights to talk about the challenges they're facing."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
